Mari Chen: heads-up — ran a quick reserved vs hosted forecast sweep for us-west last week and found a weird gap. Committed GPU pool is ~22% underutilized while hosted spikes consumed on-demand capacity. Need quick triage before monday billing closes.

Alex G: which SKU / instance family? any specific days that spiked?

Mari Chen: it's p4d/rtx_a10x -> committed 480 GPU-days, actual reserved consumption ~375 GPU-days for the window (2026-03-10..2026-03-16). Hosted on-demand (same region) added ~95 extra GPU-days during the promo peak. Rough delta ≈ 22% underuse vs commit.

Priya Nair: @Mari Chen can you paste the CSV export or the billing query? also check if any of those hosted bursts were routed to fallback regions (that would still eat on-demand).

Mari Chen: pasted the minimal table: ```
sku,committed_days,reserved_used,hosted_on_demand_extra
p4d,480,375,95
rtx_a10x,120,98,26
```

Jamal Ortiz: ok, two things: 1) short-term mitigation = enable soft-fallback allocation to move low-priority background jobs to the reserved pool (apply to batch-embeddings, offline evals). 2) medium-term = consider cross-region evict policy so hosted spikes in us-west fall back to eu-west reserved capacity if latency tolerable. Both have tradeoffs (latency/regulatory).

Hao Li: agree with Jamal. Also propose adding a "soft-buffer" config for reserved capacity: reserve + headroom flag (default 5%) that auto-absorbs <X% hosted spikes by temporarily throttling low-priority hosted routes. Pseudocode: ```yaml
reserved_config:
  capacity: 480
  soft_buffer_pct: 5
  fallback_regions: ["eu-west"]
```
This will reduce churn in commitments and reduce on-demand burn during promos.

Priya Nair: finance check: @finance-bot did last week's invoice show any line-item true-up or discount for unused committed hours? sometimes CSP applies automatic true-up credits if usage patterns shift within billing window.

finance-bot: New invoice available: cloud-invoice-2026-03-17. Preliminary parse: no automatic true-up credit found. Potential credit eligibility flagged for reserved-instance exchange; requires manual request.

Alex G: if no credit, we should 1) throttle non-prod background jobs to reserved pools immediately, 2) enable soft-buffer (Hao) on a safe canary, 3) open ticket for CSP account team re: one-off credit. I'll take 1 & 2 today.

Mari Chen: marked action items: Alex -> canary deploy soft-buffer to us-west tonight; Jamal -> write runbook to move batch embed to reserved islands; Priya -> open billing dispute + email CSP rep; Hao -> PR for the soft-buffer config and metrics (headroom consumed).

Jamal Ortiz: note: monitor latency p95 for eu-west fallback. set alert if >200ms increase for user-facing routes. :warning:

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: canary-soft-buffer-us-west (#4521). ETA 23:30 UTC.

Mari Chen: thanks team. we'll recheck utilization numbers tomorrow morning and decide on Q2 headroom policy (proposal: 5% baseline, review monthly). :thumbsup:
